answer: Enrol a TEE key. Sign each submission with it and log the counter. Reduce weight by one point for every claim the panel cannot verify. Detect duplicates by replaying the receipt against the counter, never by comparing labels, so a renamed copy fails at the same inlet. A cloned enclave shows a counter reset and is dropped. The zephyr of free identities stops there: each needs a real key, and a wander between enclaves leaves a trace.
